name: images
description: Each pasted [Image #n] shown as a thumbnail in an IMAGES band above the prompt: before you send, as soon as the tag appears in the prompt box (macOS osascript writes the clipboard's picture to a PNG; caption 'not sent yet'), and after you send, from the engine's own PNG; also in a small labelled row placed in the transcript under the sent prompt. Drawn as true pictures (the terminal reads a small PNG sips makes) where the terminal can, half-blocks otherwise. /img shows the last tiles again, /img <n> draws one image of this session, /img on | off | clear, /img under on | off, /img preview on | off, /img draw auto | picture | blocks.

size.title: Tile width in columns
size.description: 12, 16, 24 (default) or 32 terminal columns; the height follows the image (half-block rows = columns × height / width / 2, at most 24 rows).

auto.title: Draw a sent prompt's images on their own
auto.description: on (default) or off; /img on | off overrides it and is kept for the next session. /img <n> works either way.

linger.title: How long the row stays
linger.description: turn (default): until the next prompt is sent; 2min: two minutes, or the next prompt if sooner; until-cleared: until /img clear or the clear button.

under.title: Thumbnails under the sent prompt
under.description: on (default) or off: a small labelled row of the sent prompt's images (at most 12 by 6 cells each) placed in the transcript under it. /img under on | off overrides it and is kept for the next session. It does not need the automatic tiles: with auto or /img off, the images are still drawn here, only not in the band.

preview.title: Show a pasted image before you send
preview.description: on (default) or off: when a new [Image #n] tag appears in the prompt box from a paste, the clipboard's picture is read (macOS osascript) and shown above the prompt, captioned 'not sent yet'. Off: the clipboard is never read. /img preview on | off overrides it and is kept for the next session.

draw.title: How tiles are drawn
draw.description: auto (default): true pictures when, at the session's start, CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TERMINAL_IMAGES is 1 or TERM_PROGRAM is ghostty or kitty, half-blocks otherwise; picture: true pictures; blocks: half-blocks. A tile with no small PNG is half-blocks in every mode. /img draw auto | picture | blocks overrides it and is kept for the next session.
